findings.location: source.html — paragraph: "Emily collected bags of chips, and Kianna ran down to the basement to grab a few apples."
findings.source_quote: "Emily collected bags of chips, and Kianna ran down to the basement to grab a few apples."
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the mistranslated noun with the correct Afrikaans word for 'apples' and preserve surrounding HTML. For example: change “om ’n paar appelteë te kry” to “om ’n paar appels te kry”.

findings.location: source.html — paragraph: “'Adrianna, can you please take ours too?' begged Emily.”
findings.source_quote: "Adrianna, can you please take ours too?" begged Emily.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the mistranscribed/misspelled Afrikaans word so it clearly reads 'ours' (ons) and preserves HTML. For example: change “Adrianna, kan jy asseblief onsne ook neem?” to “Adrianna, kan jy asseblief ons ook neem?”
findings.translation_quote: "Adrianna, kan jy asseblief onsne ook neem?" vra Emily.

findings.location: source.html — paragraph: “'Oh, yes, I guess she did. Well, they can play on the swings or something,' she shrugged"
findings.source_quote: "Oh, yes, I guess she did. Well, they can play on the swings or something," she shrugged
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust Afrikaans word order for naturalness while keeping meaning and HTML intact. For example: change “skouerhaal sy.” to “sy skouerhaal.”
findings.translation_quote: "O, ja, ek dink sy het. Wel, hulle kan op die swaaie speel of iets anders," skouerhaal sy.

findings.location: source.html — paragraph: "She stepped out of the kayak, pulled it out of the water and flipped it over to dry."
findings.source_quote: "She stepped out of the kayak, pulled it out of the water and flipped it over to dry."
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the infinitive phrase to be grammatical Afrikaans while preserving HTML. For example: change “draai dit om om te droog.” to “draai dit om om dit droog te maak.” or “draai dit om om dit te laat droog word.”
findings.translation_quote: "Sy stap uit die kajak, trek dit uit die water en draai dit om om te droog."
